properties.name: text
properties.description: Alternative for default slot/children. Do not use together with a text children/slot, as both will be rendered and result in duplicate labels.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Define an icon by its identifier (like e.g. _user_, compare to [Icons](https://design-system.deutschebahn.com/core-web/review/main/foundations/icons/overview)) to get displayed in front of the elements content.

properties.name: showIcon
properties.description:
Enables or disables the visibility of the icon. The default value depends on the component.
For many components this property is optional to reflect Figma properties.

properties.name: endSlot
properties.description: Slot for end content, for example add a custom component between an icon and a label.

design.name: 📦 End Slot
design.note: Absent on all Popover sets, horizontal and vertical.

design.name: 👁️ Show End Slot
design.note: Absent on all Popover sets, horizontal and vertical.

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: This is for mobile navigation only, if it is set the sub-navigation is a static overlay

design.name: 🔀 Expanded
design.note: A boolean in popover-group and a variant in tree-group, because Tree switches its icon between the two states. In popover-group-desktop-vertical it is also a boolean, but with the 👁️ prefix instead of 🔀. Absent in drill-down-group, where the expanded state is handled by the parent CP Navigation Drill Down instead. In code this prop sits on DBControlPanelNavigationItemGroup.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: The disabled attribute can be set to keep a user from clicking on the item.

properties.name: tooltip
properties.description:
If you use DBShell with controlPanelDesktopPosition="left" or DBControlPanelFlatIcon
you need to add a tooltip for collapsed navigation

properties.name: backButtonId
properties.description: The backButtonId attribute changes the id inside the back button.

properties.name: backButtonText
properties.description: The backButtonText attribute changes the text inside the back button.
